text:
maria: Heads-up — savings plan coverage in us-west-2 dropped ~18% over the last 24h, cost alert flagged a jump in on‑demand GPU spend :alert: · cc @ajay @leo
ajay: Yikes. Any correlation with recent scale events or new SKUs?
leo: I ran a quick look: most on‑demand is coming from p4d and a handful of p3dn that were launched yesterday in us-west-2b. Reservations are regional but some RI/SPs are zonal/tenancy bound. Could be AZ skew.
sophie: infra-bot posted this automated signal earlier:
infra-bot: cost-alert: savings-plan-coverage us-west-2 = 62% (threshold 80%). estimated daily on-demand gpu = $3.2k, baseline expected = $600/day. see: https://console.costs.example/redwood/prod/us-west-2/costs
ajay: That link shows a grouping by instance family. If some reserved instances were exchanged to a different tenancy or were converted to a different AZ, they won't attach. Can you paste the reservation summary?
leo: Quick reservation table snippet (pulled from billing UI):
```
ReservationId   InstanceType   Scope    Tenancy   StartDate     Utilization%
r-0a1b2c3d      p4d.24xlarge   Availability Zone   default   2024-11-01   73%
r-4e5f6g7h      p3dn.24xlarge   Region  dedicated  2023-08-15   98%
```
leo: Notice r-0a1b2c3d is AZ-scoped to us-west-2a, but most usage yesterday was in 2b. Looks like some recent node provisioning landed in 2b because of spot shortages in 2a.
maria: OK — so AZ misalignment plus a few dedicated tenancy reservations that don't match default launches. Action: find instances not covered by SP/RI, rehome or exchange where possible.
ajay: Running a tag-based query to identify unassociated instances: `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod Name=instance-type,Values=p4d.24xlarge,p3dn.24xlarge --region us-west-2`
sophie: Also adding a quick Athena cost query to get hourly attachment rates and confirm when the delta started. If it lines up with last night's autoscale, that's our root cause.
leo: Short term mitigation options: 1) Force new launches into us-west-2a by updating ASG AZ weights (if capacity ok). 2) Temporarily bump Dedicated pool (we can burst into reserved pool if we have spare capacity). 3) Exchange the AZ-scoped reservation to region-scoped via console (if allowed) but that may incur a pro-rated adjustment.
maria: Prefer 1 + 3: move ASG weight to favor 2a, and open an exchange ticket on the zonal reservation. Ajay/Sophie, can you own the ASG tweak + validation? Leo will draft the reservation exchange steps and estimate cost delta.
ajay: I'll push a conservative ASG change now (`asg update --name gpu-prod --availability-zones us-west-2a=0.75,us-west-2b=0.25`) and monitor. Posting a diff in #infra-changes.
sophie: Confirming Athena query in 5m and will drop a csv of uncovered instance ids.
leo: Draft exchange steps:
- Pull reservation id and check convertible eligibility
- Estimate pro-rated cost from AWS console
- Open finance approval ticket with estimated delta
- Execute exchange during low-traffic window
I'll paste the console steps after finance runbook ready.
maria: Timeline: ASG change now, Athena csv in 5-10m, reservation exchange plan and cost estimate by EOD. If finance approves, schedule exchange for tomorrow 03:00 UTC.
infra-bot: action-log: created ticket INFRA-5423 "us-west-2 SP coverage drop" assigned to ajay, leo; priority P2
ajay: Noted. Watching CPU/GPU queue latency — will rollback ASG change if we see sustained task backlogs.
sophie: Uploading uncovered instance list to ticket now. Early numbers: ~22 GPU instances running on-demand that should be covered by existing SPs if AZ aligned.
maria: Thanks team. Postmortem candidate if exchange triggers unexpected billing. Keep updates here :thumbsup:
